Name: Comics
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]Comics Mod[/heading] by Platonymous[/center][line]
Pierre offers new comic books every day in his store that you can collect or use as wall decorations.

[i]This mod includes no images on it's own, all the data/images come courtesy of [url=https://comicvine.gamespot.com/]Comicvine[/url], the rights to all comic-book-covers belong to the respective publishers and artists. API limits or connection issues may cause the shop to not sell anything from time to time.

[/i][b][i][u]IMPORTANT:[/u] Comicvine's API is limited when it comes to filtering and includes next to main stream comics also a number of NSFW Manga which will show up every now and then. Because of this I have marked the whole mod as [u]NSFW[/u]. Use at your own discretion.[/i]
[/b]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img]
This mods adds a second shop menu to Pierre's, that sells comics. You can open it by clicking on the counter left of where the bags are sold.
Comics can't be read, but can be used as wall-decoration.

All data and images are provided via the [url=https://comicvine.gamespot.com/]Comicvine [/url]API, as such you will need to be online to get new comics.
New comics leave and enter the shop every day, depending on the "baseYear" setting in the config file as well as how many days you've played.
Setting the "baseYear" to -1 will provide the latest of the actual IRL date, so they won't change via ingame-day. Default "baseYear" is 2010.

1.1.0 added another config option named "loadCoversInShop", which unsurprisingly controls wether or not cover images are loaded within the shop menu.
It's default value is false, so when you load the mod from 1.1.0 forward you have to change the config if you want to see the covers in the menu.
This is done to reduce image loading and lag in the menu.
[b]
[/b]Requires PlatoTK.
